snippet.title: Galactic Glitch 1.0 - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Galactic Glitch 1.0 is available NOW on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1536620/Galactic_Glitch/

Galactic Glitch is an Action-Roguelike with physics-based combat mechanics. Blast your way through the Corrupted, hurl massive rocks, catch missiles, bounce foes off walls and rip your enemies to shreds in challenging space combat. Get it on Steam today!
